Adolion: The Adventurer's Road
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
Lights Behind the Palisade
About this story
You have just signed on at the Adventurer's Guild in Aegis City, with no party yet. Belle, a headstrong barbarian, and Dalan, a shy elf ranger, are looking for one too. The postings on the board are small, the pay is modest, and every rank has to be earned. Expect frontier fantasy with a dark edge: real danger, mysteries that open one clue at a time, and choices that cost something. Bring any adventurer you like; the Guild takes all kinds.
Recently
You left The Empty Mile behind and moved into Lights Behind the Palisade.
Open threads
The dead Sheridan messenger carried word meant for Aegis City — what message, and who silenced him?
The party carries the dead Sheridan messenger's badge to Wendhope's headman — what will the headman make of it, and will the badge be believed?
The north trade road to the mines is unnaturally empty — what has stopped all traffic, and does it connect to Wendhope's silence?
The party camps off the road on the first night north — what watches the empty road while they sleep?
Wendhope's gate is barred and torches burn in daylight — why is the village sealed, and will the party be let in?
The story so far
The party took the name the Red Hands and signed on for a Rank D investigation of Wendhope, then rode north into the forest. On the road they found a Sheridan messenger face down with an arrow in his back, and Dalan watched the trees while Belle turned the body over and pried the badge loose. The mood was tense and wary, the quiet road feeling wrong to all of them.
Following along.
